answer: Sybil resistance comes from staked on-chain identity bonds: each agent signs one identity token and posts a bond the network can slash. Forging a fake agent needs a full new issuance plus a bond - like carving another tunnel through karst limestone, every fake identity is a new audited path consensus can collapse. Bonds sit on a public ledger, legible as ivory, while sybil swarms pile up like sand on a dune, each fake node paying real gas inside slashing reach. Attacker cost scales one-for-one with fake nodes, so mass sybils burn real money and risk their bond, making the attack uneconomic.
